Visualise LCZ parameters

Source: R/lcz_plot_parameters.R
lcz_plot_parameters.Rd

Maps one or more physical parameters of the LCZ scheme (sky view factor, building surface fraction, anthropogenic heat, ...) as rasters.

Usage

lcz_plot_parameters(
  x,
  iselect = NULL,
  all = FALSE,
  inclusive = FALSE,
  isave = FALSE,
  save_extension = "png",
  max_pixels = 1e+06,
  ...,
  lang = "en"
)

Arguments

x

The raster stack returned by lcz_get_parameters(istack = TRUE) (the first layer, the LCZ class, is dropped automatically).

iselect

Character vector with one or more parameter codes. See the parameter list below.

all

Logical. Plot every parameter in the stack.

inclusive

Logical. Use colour-vision-deficiency-safe palettes.

isave

Logical. Save each plot in LCZ4r_output/.

save_extension

Image format: "png", "jpg", "tif", "pdf" or "svg".

max_pixels

Maximum number of cells per plot; larger rasters are aggregated (mean) first.

...

Passed to ggplot2::labs() (subtitle, caption, ...). The title is generated from the parameter name.

lang

Language used for titles, messages and errors. See lcz_langs(). Defaults to "en".

Value

A ggplot object (the last plot when several parameters are drawn).

Parameter codes

SVFmin, SVFmax, SVFmean (sky view factor); ARmin, ARmax, ARmean (aspect ratio); BSFmin, BSFmax, BSFmean (building surface fraction); ISFmin, ISFmax, ISFmean (impervious surface fraction); PSFmin, PSFmax, PSFmean (pervious surface fraction); TSFmin, TSFmax, TSFmean (tree surface fraction); HREmin, HREmax, HREmean (height of roughness elements); TRCmin, TRCmax, TRCmean (terrain roughness class); SADmin, SADmax, SADmean (surface admittance); SALmin, SALmax, SALmean (surface albedo); AHmin, AHmax, AHmean (anthropogenic heat output); z0 (roughness length).

References

Stewart, I. D., and Oke, T. R. (2012). Local Climate Zones for urban temperature studies. Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 93(12) 1879-1900. doi:10.1175/BAMS-D-11-00019.1

See also

lcz_get_parameters(), lcz_plot_map()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lcz_map <- lcz_get_map(city = "Juiz de Fora")
params <- lcz_get_parameters(lcz_map, istack = TRUE)

lcz_plot_parameters(params, iselect = "SVFmean")
lcz_plot_parameters(params, iselect = c("BSFmean", "AHmean"), lang = "pt")
lcz_plot_parameters(params, all = TRUE, isave = TRUE)
} # }
